title: Hơi ấm cuối ngày
about: Round x14, two more to fill the album, as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm 2 bài nữa để đủ album"): sleep music in the style of albums 6-8, slow (48 bpm), strings, pad, sub, an improvised box tune, then felt. An original piece.
